read_me: Items are ranked best first. This file is complete only if the last key is "complete":true; otherwise your fetch was truncated, so say so. Items that did not fit are in signals_digest_more.json (same format).

legend.tier: source credibility prior: A official, B trusted tracker or analyst, C reporter or aggregator, D anonymous; absent for markets
legend.sid: x only: the post URL is https://x.com/<by>/status/<sid>
legend.text: headline or post text, trimmed harder for lower-ranked items
legend.flags: leak = rumor or leak vocabulary; soon = forward-looking vocabulary; id = a Claude model id or name in the text; newid = an identifier not seen in the earlier days; rising = engagement climbing fast; trip = tripwire (registry, status component, careers, sitemap, watched page changed)
legend.corr: distinct authors who mentioned the same new identifier
legend.new_lines: new text on a watched page

Claude Code uses the Claude API, including when you sign in with a Claude plan, so this page’s dates apply.
If Claude Code is set up for another platform or for a gateway, the dates are those of the platform that serves its requests.
Once the model is retired, requests to it fail.
If you use Claude Code, update it first, because a newer model can need a newer version of Claude Code.
Then, check which model you’re using, even if you set no model or use a Claude Code alias such as sonnet.

new_lines: November 17, 2026 We’ve launched Linked billing in beta with the user-profiles-billing-2026-10-01 beta header.
Your customers can now pay for the Claude usage in your app through their own Claude organization.
Once a customer links their organization, set billing_policy on each /v1/messages or /v1/chat/completions request to choose who pays.
In the Claude Console, customers can set a spend cap for your app or unlink your app.
Linked billing works for customers whose organization pays Anthropic directly for API usage.
